instruction: A candid action photograph with a low-angle medium full shot captures a sunny outdoor concrete pier with hills in the background. In the foreground right, the woman with light brown hair in a half-up bun (R6), wearing a striped mesh crop top and ripped jeans, is in a low squatting dance pose with her arm extended, smiling at the camera. In the background left, the woman with curly dark hair (R5), wearing a black mesh top and tan leggings, squats playfully with a puckered expression and a raised hand. The two women perform a coordinated, energetic dance routine together. Bright, direct sunlight illuminates the scene, casting soft shadows and highlighting the warm, natural colors.
